onboarding.startHint: Setup takes about 20 minutes. TubeForge guides you; Google pages open in a new tab.
onboarding.reconnectHint: This channel was disconnected. Reconnecting starts the YouTube steps again.

CREATE_GOOGLE_ACCOUNT.title: Google account
CREATE_GOOGLE_ACCOUNT.how: Use a Google account you control. For testing, a separate account keeps your main one tidy.

CREATE_CHANNEL.title: YouTube channel
CREATE_CHANNEL.how: Create the YouTube channel on that account. Start with a test channel for private uploads.

VERIFY_PHONE.title: Verify the channel
VERIFY_PHONE.how: Verify by phone in YouTube. It unlocks custom thumbnails and longer videos.

CREATE_GCP_PROJECT.title: Google Cloud project (no billing)
CREATE_GCP_PROJECT.how: Create a free Google Cloud project, e.g. tubeforge-youtube. Do not add a billing account — TubeForge never needs one.

ENABLE_APIS.title: Turn on the YouTube APIs
ENABLE_APIS.how: In that project, enable “YouTube Data API v3” and “YouTube Analytics API”.

CONSENT_SCREEN.title: OAuth consent screen
CONSENT_SCREEN.how: Choose External, name it “TubeForge (personal)”, add your privacy-policy link and add your own Google account as a test user.

OAUTH_CLIENT.title: OAuth client (Desktop app)
OAUTH_CLIENT.how: Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Desktop app. Paste the Client ID (and secret, if shown) below. They are stored encrypted.

PRIVACY_POLICY.title: Privacy policy link
PRIVACY_POLICY.how: Publish site/privacy.html from this repository on GitHub Pages (fill in your name and e-mail first) and paste its address here.

CONNECT.title: Connect with Google
CONNECT.how: Sign in with the channel's Google account and tick every permission box. Then confirm it is the right channel.

TEST_UPLOAD.title: Private test upload
TEST_UPLOAD.how: TubeForge uploads a 5-second test clip as private. Check it in YouTube Studio, then delete it if you like.
